slots.feeling: two people held apart by a silence they both chose

candidates.source_quote: silence is not the absence of sound. / It is when both know what to say and choose not to.
candidates.why: Two figures at opposite ends of a blank lit wall, neither stepping closer: the voice of a silence that is chosen, not empty.

candidates.source_quote: It's presence. Like Malevich's white — not emptiness but all colors at once.
candidates.why: The broken-white wall felt from inside: the blank is not absence but everything held back, which is what the two of them carry.

candidates.source_quote: "Blanc cassé," the clerk said, and Kira thought then that it sounded like a diagnosis. Broken white.
candidates.why: The colour of the wall heard as a diagnosis: a cold, clinical opening to a contract that will break.

slots.feeling: heat of a breath that never becomes a touch

candidates.source_quote: He does not touch her. He simply stands close enough that she feels the heat of his body through the fabric.
candidates.why: Exactly what her skin feels at the nape: heat through cloth, a gap that never closes. Nearness without seduction.

candidates.source_quote: Так пустить бы по венам жар... / Но все плещется полутьма... / Ты - наверное - Божий дар. / Я - наверное - "Я сама".
candidates.why: Her inner voice as his breath reaches her: the wish for heat, and the proud self-sufficiency that keeps her still.
candidates.gist_en: If only I could send heat through my veins... / but the half-dark keeps lapping... / You are, perhaps, a gift from God. / I am, perhaps, 'I'll do it myself.'

candidates.source_quote: His hands on the Gauguin catalogue, long fingers sliding across the reproduction of Nevermore (1897), and she feels... not attraction, something more dangerous. Recognition.
candidates.why: Names the bond precisely: not attraction, recognition, and the danger she feels with him this close.

slots.feeling: a kiss given to ice because no one is expected

candidates.source_quote: Поцелуя не жду. Губами / Расцелую я лед на стеклах.
candidates.why: Literally her gesture at the frosted pane, and the loneliness under it: she expects no kiss, so she gives one to the cold.
candidates.gist_en: I'm not waiting for a kiss. With my lips / I will kiss the ice on the windowpanes.

candidates.source_quote: Впитались слезы в стекло. / И что-то вдруг вытекло. / Это верно, душа, вылилась неспеша.
candidates.why: The meltwater running down the glass becomes her own soul seeping out, quietly.
candidates.gist_en: Tears soaked into the glass. / And something suddenly ran out. / That must be the soul, pouring out slowly.

candidates.source_quote: You'll feel Eternity. She'll touch your lips, / grow warmer, and your word will forget belonging.
candidates.why: Something touches her lips and grows warmer, the way the frost melts into a clear oval under her mouth.

slots.feeling: a burnt soul lifting off, glowing as it goes

candidates.source_quote: А мне - благодать. Догорать. Догорать.
candidates.why: The ember-veined leaf rising through the storm: burning out felt as grace, not loss. Short and sharp.
candidates.gist_en: And for me, a blessing. To burn down. To burn down.

candidates.source_quote: Плавно кружатся листья к нам в раскаленную плазму.
candidates.why: A leaf glowing like an ember against a black sky: almost literal, and the heat is emotional.
candidates.gist_en: The leaves slowly whirl down to us into the red-hot plasma.

candidates.source_quote: Нам любые дороги дороги - / Там, где ты опять готов родиться.
candidates.why: A single leaf rising instead of falling: departure felt as a second birth.
candidates.gist_en: Every road is dear to us, / the one where you are ready to be born again.

slots.feeling: letting go into dark water, eyes open, a dare

candidates.source_quote: One day I'll drown / In cool silence / And drift to sleep.
candidates.why: Her floating stillness and the slip under: drowning not as panic but as cool silence and sleep.

candidates.source_quote: Море волнуется раз. / Море волнуется два. / Наживка с крючка сорвалась. / Я шлепнулась и уплыла.
candidates.why: The children's game played on a black sea: she breaks loose before 'freeze' and slips away under the water.
candidates.gist_en: The sea is stirring, one. / The sea is stirring, two. / The bait tore off the hook. / I flopped in and swam away.

candidates.source_quote: "Я люблю" - шум немой реки, / Дважды топящей всех готовых.
candidates.why: An aphorism with a wound in it: water that takes the ones who are ready, as she goes under.
candidates.gist_en: 'I love you' is the noise of a mute river / that drowns twice everyone who is ready.

slots.feeling: wings not yet grown; a waiting body

candidates.source_quote: Я тебя крылатая, дождусь, / перьями подушку набиваю.
candidates.why: Three wet feathers on her shoulder blade: half-grown wings, and patient waiting in her still back.
candidates.gist_en: Winged, I will wait for you, / stuffing a pillow with feathers.

candidates.source_quote: Дожить, чтоб наголо отдаться / Кому-то в шкуре без брони.
candidates.why: Her bare back rising from the sea: skin without armour, the vulnerability she both fears and wants.
candidates.gist_en: To live long enough to give yourself, stripped bare, / to someone, in a skin without armour.

candidates.source_quote: Стая птиц, что ты раньше не встретил.
candidates.why: The feathers as traces of something unknown that passed over her: strange, light, a little uncanny.
candidates.gist_en: A flock of birds you have never met before.

slots.feeling: a shed skin left on the sand; someone has gone

candidates.source_quote: Зря ты снова сбросил чешую / там, где я тихонечко взлетаю.
candidates.why: The pearl scales and the lone footprint: what was shed is left behind, and whoever left it has already lifted off.
candidates.gist_en: In vain you shed your scales again / there, where I am quietly taking off.

candidates.source_quote: Зря ты поломал мои крючки. Рыбы не кончают суицидом. / Бабочки, попавшие в сачки, крылья свои сбросят паразитам.
candidates.why: Scales and wings as proof of survival: a bitter, sharp turn that makes the empty beach feel like aftermath.
candidates.gist_en: You broke my fishhooks for nothing. Fish don't commit suicide. / Butterflies caught in nets will shed their wings to the parasites.

candidates.source_quote: Снова твои следы высохли без воды.
candidates.why: The footprint in the sand: absence in one line, someone who was here and is gone.
candidates.gist_en: Again your footprints dried up without water.

slots.feeling: breathing the island in before seeing it

candidates.source_quote: Morning in Atuona doesn't begin with light. / It begins with scent.
candidates.why: She breathes in with lowered lids: scent before light, which is exactly this shot.

candidates.source_quote: Like the desert learned to cry flowers despite itself.
candidates.why: Steam off the black sand tinted like scent: a hard landscape that learned to bloom anyway, as she does.

candidates.source_quote: Outside the Pacific breathed its ancient rhythm — inhale, exhale, without emphasis.
candidates.why: Her one slow breath matched to the ocean's: calm, no drama, the body syncing with the island.

slots.feeling: slow, heavy heat; a body as a canvas for light

candidates.source_quote: Kira woke to heat. / Sheets stuck to skin like a second dress. / Through the shutters — Atuona morning, thick as honey. / The air tastes of frangipani and rust.
candidates.why: The honey stripe on her shoulder and the half-open eyes: waking into heat, honey and a faint taste of rust.

candidates.source_quote: Light breaks against silk, runs over skin like Renoir's brush in The Bathers. / Each touch commits to the body. No rollback.
candidates.why: Light running over her skin like a brushstroke, every touch of it irreversible.

candidates.source_quote: Renoir in his last years painted with brushes tied to his arthritis-twisted fingers. / Pain didn't leave — it became part of the light.
candidates.why: The pale forehead scar in warm light: pain that has not left but has become part of the light.

slots.feeling: skin answering the air; a first, private touch

candidates.source_quote: Skin meets air like first kiss.
candidates.why: The fine hairs lifting on her shoulder blade: skin meeting air, intimate with no one else there.

candidates.source_quote: The body stays. / The light moves.
candidates.why: Her stillness under the moving stripe of light: the film's own rule spoken as her calm.

candidates.source_quote: The fabric falls like forgiveness.
candidates.why: The white sheet over her: softness, release, a fabric that forgives.

slots.feeling: the double dares to undress what she holds back

candidates.source_quote: Что ж так рвешься в мой плен суровый? / Ну же, с плеч приспусти бретели... / Ради Бога, не будь хладнокровна, / Убивая меня в постели!
candidates.why: The still woman speaking to her freer reflection as it lowers a strap: longing addressed as a seductive double.
candidates.gist_en: Why are you straining into my harsh captivity? / Come on, slip the straps down off your shoulders... / For God's sake, don't be cold-blooded / when you kill me in bed!

candidates.source_quote: But here, in this light... / She sees what Gauguin might have painted. / Not Vogue beautiful. / Human beautiful.
candidates.why: The mirror shows daylight while she stands in red night: she sees herself as a painter would, human rather than Vogue.

candidates.source_quote: You know how it is - sometimes the masterpiece hides in the mirror.
candidates.why: The mirror holds the other version of her: the real work hides there.

slots.feeling: watching a woman held like property

candidates.source_quote: He holds her waist like she's another lot with a pre-sale estimate.
candidates.why: His palm on Mila's waist as Kira watches from behind: the owner's hold, seen through a collector's eye.

candidates.source_quote: "J. — looks at her like the last ticket out of hell."
candidates.why: The way he walks her down the jetty: not love, escape. She is his way out.

candidates.source_quote: Продаешься, я - не продаюсь.
candidates.why: Kira's silent verdict as the couple approaches: a hard line between herself and what she sees.
candidates.gist_en: You sell yourself. I am not for sale.

slots.feeling: recognising another woman's pain without a word

candidates.source_quote: Knows this pain by name. / Knows how it smells in the morning.
candidates.why: Kira's held gaze while his fingers tighten on Mila's wrist behind her: she knows this pain by name.

candidates.source_quote: Плачут ночные лисицы. / Слезы их мне знакомы.
candidates.why: Recognition between women: Kira hears Mila's silent crying because it was once her own.
candidates.gist_en: The night vixens are crying. / I know their tears.

candidates.source_quote: She extends her hand — thin fingers, nude Dior manicure, Cartier Love bracelet with scratches that tell a story better than any words.
candidates.why: The bangle at the gripped wrist: the scratches tell what Mila cannot say.

slots.feeling: walking into the storm, armoured in the dress

candidates.source_quote: Ей - ни тени сомненья, / В том, что шаг станет твердым.
candidates.why: Her steady walk toward the lens through wind and rain: certainty in every step.
candidates.gist_en: Not a shadow of doubt / that the step will be firm.

candidates.source_quote: Сегодня я у руля, / Иконы свои смоля.
candidates.why: She owns the storm: in command, and slightly blasphemous about it.
candidates.gist_en: Today I'm at the helm, / tarring my own icons.

candidates.source_quote: On Kira it was devastating.
candidates.why: The dress as a weapon: short and sharp, the effect she walks in with.

slots.feeling: being fastened, priced and kept, and enduring it

candidates.source_quote: Эти смыслы навечно срослись - эротика и активы, / Их - под лютый конвой - они целы и невредимы.
candidates.why: Emeralds closing on her throat while she stares at the lens: desire and capital fused, guarded like a convoy.
candidates.gist_en: These meanings have grown together forever: the erotic and the assets. / Put them under fierce escort and they stay whole and unharmed.

candidates.source_quote: I've searched for them all my life. I'd buy them from her for my collection.
candidates.why: His inner voice as he fastens the clasp: he looks at her as a collector, not a lover.

candidates.source_quote: Ule was generous only with exhibits for his collections. Otherwise he was deaf and mute to any creature with veins filled with hot blood.
candidates.why: Gift as acquisition: his generosity goes only to exhibits, and the necklace makes her one.

slots.feeling: a perfect face cracking like old varnish

candidates.source_quote: "M. — mask too tight, cracks by the eyes."
candidates.why: The craquelure at Mila's eye under his studying gaze: the mask is too tight and it shows.

candidates.source_quote: Я тебя не найду: страждет холст под невзрачною маской...
candidates.why: She is a canvas under examination, and the real woman cannot be found under the mask.
candidates.gist_en: I won't find you: the canvas is suffering under a drab mask...

candidates.source_quote: Ты - роль без роли.
candidates.why: The model's emptiness in one line: a part performed with no self left inside it.
candidates.gist_en: You are a role without a role.

slots.feeling: slipping away; his hand closes on air

candidates.source_quote: Что было, то было. / Теперь ты учись, Ничей.
candidates.why: She rises and leaves him grasping empty air: the cold, final turn of someone walking out.
candidates.gist_en: What was, was. / Now it's your turn to learn, Nobody's man.

candidates.source_quote: Застегнувшись с запАхом, / Шла Душа с Карнавала.
candidates.why: Her quiet exit in white silk: leaving the carnival with dignity intact.
candidates.gist_en: Buttoned up, wrapped tight, / the Soul was walking away from the Carnival.

candidates.source_quote: Если ушло - не надо. / Если простить - прости.
candidates.why: The hand closing on nothing: the answer to grasping is letting go.
candidates.gist_en: If it has gone, let it go. / If you forgive, forgive.

slots.feeling: a woman fading into her own reflection

candidates.source_quote: Mila caught his gaze and smiled slightly — that smile people wear when they've already decided on their own disappearance.
candidates.why: Mila half-transparent in the window, looking back: the smile of someone who has already chosen to disappear.

candidates.source_quote: Violet in the desert — / that's her in high fashion. / Too fragile for this industry, / but stubbornly alive.
candidates.why: The fragile model glowing on the window seat: too delicate for her world, still alive.

candidates.source_quote: I watch her bare feet — white as the dress, like she's never known sun.
candidates.why: Her bare feet and the shoes left on the floor: a woman white as a ghost, untouched by daylight.

slots.feeling: a sleepless vigil, staring the beast down

candidates.source_quote: And when she wants to blink or sleep – she props them open with matches. Otherwise the sleeping Beast will wake and want meat again.
candidates.why: The match burning at her open eye in the cage: the unblinking vigil that keeps her addiction asleep.

candidates.source_quote: Только миг, где попутчики, / Только миг, где рассветились. / Мы с тобой неразлучники, / В клетке ждем равноденствия.
candidates.why: The two of them locked in the cage, waiting: bound by the waiting, not by romance.
candidates.gist_en: Only a moment where we are fellow travellers, / only a moment where we dawned. / You and I are inseparables, / waiting in a cage for the equinox.

candidates.source_quote: Ночь — интересный период. / Нету ни сна. Ни яви.
candidates.why: The storm-lit stillness between them: the in-between of insomnia, neither dream nor waking.
candidates.gist_en: Night is an interesting time. / There is no sleep. No waking.

slots.feeling: asking again for what she refused by day

candidates.source_quote: Принадлежность дневных сомнений / Принимает ночной оборот / И протягивает решенье / Снова задом, да, наперёд.
candidates.why: She asked him to fasten it again: night reverses the day's resolve, and she knows it.
candidates.gist_en: The daytime doubts / take a nighttime turn / and hand over the decision / back to front, yes, all over again.

candidates.source_quote: Fashion is body language we choose each morning. But what if the body itself becomes canvas?
candidates.why: Jewels on a wet bare back: the body turned into the canvas a collector works on.

candidates.source_quote: Печалиться повремени! / Хоть бой в висок куранты - вьюгой.. / Себя ты отдала подругой, / В ответ - растраченные дни.
candidates.why: A fastening that costs her: what she gave and what came back. The bitter calm in her shoulders.
candidates.gist_en: Hold off on grieving! / Though the clock strikes the temple like a blizzard... / You gave yourself away as a friend, / and got squandered days in return.

slots.feeling: seeing something that should not be there

candidates.source_quote: Fact: dogs aren't red. / Fact: it has no shadow. / Fact: Gauguin never explained its meaning.
candidates.why: Her eyes lifting to the empty beach where a shadowless red dog appears: impossible facts, calmly stated.

candidates.source_quote: the painting isn't there. / It remains in the gap / between what is / and what the artist decided to see.
candidates.why: She looks at what the island lets her see: the real thing lives in the gap between fact and vision.

candidates.source_quote: В бою до конца за почести / Прикоснуться к иной реальности.
candidates.why: Hard noon on black sand, then the gaze to the right: the push to touch another reality.
candidates.gist_en: Fighting to the end for the honour / of touching another reality.

slots.feeling: touching words cut too deep to forgive

candidates.source_quote: Words that could never be printed. / Words that still haven’t been forgiven.
candidates.why: Her fingertips in the carved grooves: rage and taboo cut into the wood, still unforgiven.

candidates.source_quote: Ржавые мифы по лезвию. / Тупится новая бритва.
candidates.why: Old carving and a sharp edge: myths cut into wood, a blade dulled by them.
candidates.gist_en: Rusty myths along the blade. / The new razor goes blunt.

candidates.source_quote: As if reading braille written on the semantic layer.
candidates.why: Fingertips gliding along the relief as if reading: touch as a way of reading what is hidden.

slots.feeling: blood as ink; the vein becomes a line of code

candidates.source_quote: Like the keyboard of Cursor at three in the morning when code is no longer code but the continuation of a vein.
candidates.why: Light running along her vein where code will be composited: the code is her bloodstream.

candidates.source_quote: This is her carving. / Not on breadfruit wood / but in TypeScript. / Same rage.
candidates.why: Her forearm as the carving surface: the same rage as the wood, a new medium.

candidates.source_quote: Так пустить бы по венам жар... / Но все плещется полутьма...
candidates.why: The cool blue vein waiting for warmth: longing felt in the blood itself.
candidates.gist_en: If only I could send heat through my veins... / but the half-dark keeps lapping...

slots.feeling: the smell of fear in a room of buyers

candidates.source_quote: The hall reeks of expensive perfume and fear. Yes, fear – she's learned to smell it over the years.
candidates.why: She sits still among drifting paddles: what she senses in the room is fear dressed as money.

candidates.source_quote: Like I'm at a funeral, she thinks. Maybe I am.
candidates.why: Her inner voice, in black, in the third row: the sale feels like mourning.

candidates.source_quote: "Every bid will be visible as blood on snow."
candidates.why: Crimson spreading over white paddles: every bid as blood on snow.

slots.feeling: a man sensing the secret under his palm

candidates.source_quote: And suddenly he gets it – the painting is the house itself.
candidates.why: His palm on the wall as old colours bloom under it: the moment he understands where paradise is.

candidates.source_quote: The air smelled not of tropical flowers — it smelled of time.
candidates.why: Dust in the sunbeam and a fresco surfacing: the room breathes time rather than scent.

candidates.source_quote: He didn't hire her for work — he hired a mirror.
candidates.why: His wary look back over his shoulder: what he really hired her for is something he does not say.

slots.feeling: finding a secret, and its weight

candidates.source_quote: В животе засосало. Не от голода — от узнавания.
candidates.why: Her hand drawing the swollen notebook out of the light: the jolt of recognising what she has found.
candidates.gist_en: Her stomach clenched. Not from hunger, from recognition.

candidates.source_quote: Knows exactly where I turned — and where I never came back.
candidates.why: Someone wrote her road map: the notebook knows where she turned and never came back.

candidates.source_quote: Paradise is not painted. / Paradise is compiled.
candidates.why: The notebook's thesis in two short lines: paradise is not painted, it is compiled.

slots.feeling: after the lie: what cannot be taken back

candidates.source_quote: Some messages aren't notifications. / They're commits. / And once confirmed, / there's no rollback.
candidates.why: Ule at the rain window after her 'Nothing': a lie that, once said, has no rollback.

candidates.source_quote: Ты - не Авель, но и я - не Каин,
candidates.why: Betrayal and its refusal in one line: they wound each other, but neither is the murderer.
candidates.gist_en: You are not Abel, but I am not Cain either.

candidates.source_quote: Что-то где-то тихо потерялось. / Это мне отселе не уснуть.
candidates.why: His still watch over the night bay: something went missing, and sleep will not come.
candidates.gist_en: Something somewhere has quietly been lost. / From here on, it's me who cannot sleep.

slots.feeling: the man who never cries, crying

candidates.source_quote: "Не заплачу никогда...", / Но слеза вдруг до упора / Жмет на тормоз разговора / Струйкой стаявшего льда.
candidates.why: A single tear on Ule's still face: the vow broken without a sound.
candidates.gist_en: 'I'll never cry...' / but a tear suddenly slams / the brake on the conversation, all the way down, / in a trickle of melted ice.

candidates.source_quote: Tears flowed on their own, no sobbing. Just data streaming down the face.
candidates.why: His tears with no sobbing and no frown: crying as something that simply runs, like data.

candidates.source_quote: Personally, I prefer to drown silently. Kira, the rains have long burned my dreams with ice...
candidates.why: Ule's own inner voice: silent drowning, dreams burned by rain and ice.

slots.feeling: a light, costly touch that reads another's grief

candidates.source_quote: Здравствуй, друг, мне бы к тебе прикоснуться легонько, чуть-чуть, / Но так дорого стоит это тепло, выше всяких валют,
candidates.why: Her fingertip on his salt trail: a friend's touch, light and expensive. Recognition, not romance.
candidates.gist_en: Hello, friend, I'd like to touch you, lightly, just a little, / but this warmth costs so much, more than any currency,

candidates.source_quote: Ule wiped his face. Salt left white trails on his skin — like maps of countries that don't exist.
candidates.why: Her fingertip follows the white salt line as if reading a map of countries that don't exist.

candidates.source_quote: Зачем пришел? Давно уж розданный / Другим, не мне... / Что ж, будешь гостем этой осенью / В Моей Стране.
candidates.why: She lets him into her inner country, as a guest, not a possession.
candidates.gist_en: Why have you come? Given away long ago / to others, not to me... / Well then, this autumn you'll be a guest / in My Country.

slots.feeling: a steady pulse under the palm; held, not possessed

candidates.source_quote: Palm still on Ule’s chest. / Under the skin — steady pulse. / Not consensus. / Just proof that the chain still holds.
candidates.why: Her palm flat on his chest under drifting moon-lace: the pulse as proof that what binds them still holds.

candidates.source_quote: Moonlight from the Maison du Jouir window falls across his chest exactly along the lines Gauguin once carved into the lintel.
candidates.why: Carved light lying across his chest: Gauguin's lines laid on living skin.

candidates.source_quote: Сладких снов недосмотренных стая / Все кружит, приземляясь на лицах... / Мы друг друга с тобой листая, / Тихо сгинули в экспозициях.
candidates.why: The moon-lace drifting over their faces like landing dreams: two still faces turning into an exhibition.
candidates.gist_en: A flock of sweet, unfinished dreams / keeps circling, landing on our faces... / Leafing through each other, / we quietly vanished into the exhibits.

slots.feeling: an old wound found by a precise touch

candidates.source_quote: И ни со зла, и никак. / Просто некая точность - / Словно старый наждак, / Мне истерший кожу.
candidates.why: The fingertip tracing her scar: precision that hurts without cruelty, skin worn by time.
candidates.gist_en: Not out of malice, not in any way. / Just a certain precision, / like old sandpaper / that wore my skin away.

candidates.source_quote: Not down. / Not up. / Exactly along the line where in childhood in Moscow they gave her injections because her mother was afraid the daughter was “growing wrong.”
candidates.why: Names the scar's origin: the childhood fear that she was 'growing wrong', traced exactly.

candidates.source_quote: Same broken neckline. Same shoulder twisted in childhood and never reset.
candidates.why: A body carrying its childhood injury: the line along her spine as the mark that never healed straight.

slots.feeling: words born in the body that never sound

candidates.source_quote: Kira puts two fingers on his lips. / To feel the words born straight from the body.
candidates.why: Her two fingers on his moving lips: she feels the words before they are spoken.

candidates.source_quote: И не будем шептать лесть без фабулы и без развязки. / Лишь нелепая брань пресно звякнет в глухой суете.
candidates.why: The silenced mouth: no sweet words allowed, only what slips out.
candidates.gist_en: And we won't whisper flattery with no plot and no ending. / Only a clumsy curse will clink, flat, in the deaf bustle.

candidates.source_quote: Not hesitation. Interruption from within.
candidates.why: His lips forming words that stop: not doubt, something inside him breaking off the sentence.

slots.feeling: one word that opens everything

candidates.source_quote: Будто бы в преисподней ждет нас один пароль.
candidates.why: Her breath on his throat as she says his name: the name is the password.
candidates.gist_en: As if, in the underworld, one password is waiting for us.

candidates.source_quote: This time there is no question in his name. / Only consensus.
candidates.why: His name spoken without a question: agreement, not plea.

candidates.source_quote: Not a request. / A fork.
candidates.why: Saying his name as a turning point: not asking, choosing a path.

slots.feeling: a touch suspended; the freeze

candidates.source_quote: Ule does not kiss. / He looks.
candidates.why: His hand stopped at her jaw: he does not kiss, he looks. Recognition held in the air.

candidates.source_quote: Море волнуется раз. / Море волнуется два.
candidates.why: The storm sea in the window and the stopped hand: the children's game counts, and 'three, freeze' happens to him.
candidates.gist_en: The sea is stirring, one. / The sea is stirring, two.

candidates.source_quote: Three notes, repeat. Three notes, silence.
candidates.why: The hand that stops short of her jaw: a phrase that never reaches its fourth note, held in suspense.

slots.feeling: permission to go on living

candidates.source_quote: More like — allowance. That tomorrow will happen, and you'll be in it.
candidates.why: Her palm on his pulse: not hope, just the permission that tomorrow will come and they will be in it.

candidates.source_quote: Where it is no longer possible to lie to yourself.
candidates.why: Under her fingers, his pulse: the place where lying stops.

candidates.source_quote: Not a lullaby. / Not a song. / Allowance.
candidates.why: The steady pulse as an unfinished melody: not a song, an allowance.

slots.feeling: standing beside someone as a witness

candidates.source_quote: Ule places his palm on the small of her back. / Not a lover. A witness.
candidates.why: His palm resting on the small of her back as they look at the sea: not a lover, a witness.

candidates.source_quote: You already found her, he says. / Who? / The one who was supposed to die instead of you.
candidates.why: The quiet after: he recognises the one she survived for, and the dawn says the rest.

candidates.source_quote: Может встретимся, статься, однажды, / Перекурим в лиловый рассвет,
candidates.why: Lilac dawn on black sand, two people side by side: a quiet promise between companions.
candidates.gist_en: Maybe we'll meet someday, who knows, / and smoke together into the lilac dawn,

slots.feeling: two versions of one woman; a fork

candidates.source_quote: Two versions of the same woman.
candidates.why: The composite shows her twice: the line names it plainly.

candidates.source_quote: Time no longer flows. / It branches.
candidates.why: Two Kiras on the sand: time branching instead of flowing.

candidates.source_quote: Все, что сдохло во мне, в ком-то живо,
candidates.why: One self lets the other go on: the double as survival.
candidates.gist_en: All that died in me lives on in someone else.

slots.feeling: walking out of the ring, belonging to no one

candidates.source_quote: Закольцуешься чьим-то мужем. / Я останусь: ничьей женой, / Атуоной, горбатой старушкой / В целом с Богом и чуть - с Сатаной.
candidates.why: She steps out of the closed ring of foam: others close the ring, she stays nobody's wife, at peace with God and a little with the devil.
candidates.gist_en: You'll loop yourself into being someone's husband. / I will remain: nobody's wife, / Atuona, a hunchbacked old woman, / on the whole with God, and a little with Satan.

candidates.source_quote: Если ушло - не надо. / Если простить - прости. / Я - та иная Прохлада, / Что на твоем пути.
candidates.why: Her calm walk toward the lens: she is the cool presence in your path, asking for nothing.
candidates.gist_en: If it has gone, let it go. / If you forgive, forgive. / I am that other Coolness / that lies on your path.

candidates.source_quote: Я уже не твоя послушница. / И не твой этот день Рождения.
candidates.why: Leaving the ring as a rebirth: she belongs to herself now.
candidates.gist_en: I'm no longer your novice. / And this birthday isn't yours.

slots.feeling: erasure and return; everything starts again

candidates.source_quote: Все закончится одиночеством. / Снова. / И с него же начнется.
candidates.why: Foam whitens the black sand, pulls back, and it is black again: the cycle of ending and beginning.
candidates.gist_en: Everything will end in loneliness. / Again. / And it will begin with it too.

candidates.source_quote: Something will happen, spill like ocean / over granite's endless shore.
candidates.why: The thin sheet of foam spilling over the shore and drawing back: something happening and withdrawing.

candidates.source_quote: And ripples on the water / Glide like a pendulum— / They're not my enemies!
candidates.why: The ripples sliding in and out like a pendulum: the sea is not her enemy.

slots.feeling: charged silence across an empty white hall

candidates.source_quote: and now the silence is so complete / it could swallow a scream whole / and ask for more.
candidates.why: The empty gallery as a silence that swallows a scream; the two figures standing apart are held inside it.

candidates.source_quote: But it's a different silence. / Charged, like air before storm. / Between them — the unnamed. / Growing, like gravity between galaxies.
candidates.why: Names the charged, unnamed pull across the gap between them, without either of them stepping closer.

candidates.source_quote: Like Malevich's white — not emptiness but all colors at once.
candidates.why: The breathing off-white wall, a colour that doesn't exist, read as fullness rather than void.

slots.feeling: heat without touch, held breath

candidates.source_quote: He does not touch her. He simply stands close enough that she feels the heat of his body through the fabric.
candidates.why: The whole shot is the gap that never closes: warmth through tweed, no contact.

candidates.source_quote: Здравствуй, друг, мне бы к тебе прикоснуться легонько, чуть-чуть, / Но так дорого стоит это тепло, выше всяких валют,
candidates.gist_en: Hello, friend, I'd like to touch you lightly, just barely, but this warmth costs so much, more than any currency.
candidates.why: Wanting to touch and the price of warmth: restraint in an art-and-money world.

candidates.source_quote: His breath is hot, uneven — / like transactions in an overloaded network.
candidates.why: His breath at her ear, hot and uneven, in her underground code idiom.

slots.feeling: a kiss given to cold glass

candidates.source_quote: Поцелуя не жду. Губами / Расцелую я лед на стеклах.
candidates.gist_en: I don't wait for a kiss. With my lips / I will kiss the ice on the windowpanes.
candidates.why: Exactly the gesture: her lips to the frost instead of to a mouth.

candidates.source_quote: Холодные пустыни теплых чувств.
candidates.gist_en: Cold deserts of warm feelings.
candidates.why: Frost and warmth in one wound-line; the melting oval on cold glass.

candidates.source_quote: Впитались слезы в стекло. / И что-то вдруг вытекло.
candidates.gist_en: Tears soaked into the glass. / And something suddenly leaked out.
candidates.why: Meltwater running down the pane as grief leaking through.

slots.feeling: burning, letting go, rising

candidates.source_quote: И листья вальсировать будут порознь. / А мне - благодать. Догорать. Догорать.
candidates.gist_en: Leaves will waltz apart. / For me: grace. Burn down. Burn down.
candidates.why: A single ember-leaf waltzing alone; burning down as grace.

candidates.source_quote: Плавно кружатся листья к нам в раскаленную плазму.
candidates.gist_en: Leaves drift smoothly toward us into the red-hot plasma.
candidates.why: The glowing veins of a leaf turning through storm light.

candidates.source_quote: Рябины зябнущие грозди. / Закат в золе.
candidates.gist_en: Shivering rowan clusters. / Sunset in ash.
candidates.why: Ash and fire in the sky, compressed to five words.

slots.feeling: calm defiance, then surrender to the deep

candidates.source_quote: Море волнуется раз. / Море волнуется два. / Наживка с крючка сорвалась. / Я шлепнулась и уплыла.
candidates.gist_en: The sea is restless, one. / The sea is restless, two. / The bait tore off the hook. / I flopped down and swam away.
candidates.why: The children's sea game that never reaches 'freeze': she slips the hook and goes under on her own terms.

candidates.source_quote: When I drown, / All those who aren't friends, / I'll drag down with me.
candidates.why: Her unblinking stare before she sinks: drowning as a threat, not a defeat.

candidates.source_quote: "Я люблю" - шум немой реки, / Дважды топящей всех готовых.
candidates.gist_en: 'I love' is the noise of a mute river / that drowns twice everyone who is ready.
candidates.why: Black water closing over her face as the silence of love.

slots.feeling: wings drying on wet skin

candidates.source_quote: Я тебя крылатая, дождусь, / перьями подушку набиваю.
candidates.gist_en: Winged, I will wait for you, / stuffing a pillow with feathers.
candidates.why: Three white feathers on the shoulder blade: winged, waiting, half-risen.

candidates.source_quote: Salt from yesterday's tears, today's sweat. / All the same ocean.
candidates.why: Water streaming off her back: tears, sweat and sea become one.

candidates.source_quote: Every breath a gas fee the body pays just to stay here.
candidates.why: One slow breath lifting her back, priced in her code idiom.

slots.feeling: something shed on the sand, a trace left behind

candidates.source_quote: Зря ты снова сбросил чешую / там, где я тихонечко взлетаю.
candidates.gist_en: In vain you shed your scales again / right where I am quietly taking flight.
candidates.why: The shed scales on black sand, answering the feathers of the shot before.

candidates.source_quote: She doesn’t speak in manifestos. / She leaves traces.
candidates.why: A lone footprint holding the moon: she leaves traces, not statements.

candidates.source_quote: Скоро холодный пот. Скоро - больной черед. / Снова твои следы высохли без воды.
candidates.gist_en: Soon the cold sweat. Soon the sick turn. / Again your footprints have dried without water.
candidates.why: A footprint and its water: a trace that will not stay.

slots.feeling: waking by scent before light

candidates.source_quote: Morning in Atuona doesn't begin with light. / It begins with scent.
candidates.why: Exactly what the shot shows: she breathes the island in before she sees it.

candidates.source_quote: Copra rotting in the sun. Earth digesting itself.
candidates.why: The island's scent with its underground edge: paradise as a living stomach.

candidates.source_quote: ATUONA breathes deep, like the ocean before sunset.
candidates.why: Her one deep breath mirrored by the island's.

slots.feeling: heat, honeyed half-waking

candidates.source_quote: Kira woke to heat. / Sheets stuck to skin like a second dress. / Through the shutters — Atuona morning, thick as honey. / The air tastes of frangipani and rust.
candidates.why: Heat, shutters, honey light: the frame in her own words, with frangipani and rust.

candidates.source_quote: Here the sun stops you, suddenly spilling shamelessly across your face and palms. Mood like an out-of-tune clarinet.
candidates.why: The stripe of sun spilling over skin, and the off-key mood of waking.

candidates.source_quote: Сладких снов недосмотренных стая / Все кружит, приземляясь на лицах...
candidates.gist_en: A flock of sweet, unfinished dreams / keeps circling, landing on faces...
candidates.why: Dreams still landing on her face as she half-wakes.

slots.feeling: exposed tenderness, skin answering light

candidates.source_quote: The body stays. / The light moves.
candidates.why: Her aphorism and the law of this film: she stays still and the light travels.

candidates.source_quote: Skin meets air like first kiss.
candidates.why: Skin meeting air and light as a first touch.

candidates.source_quote: Дожить, чтоб наголо отдаться / Кому-то в шкуре без брони.
candidates.gist_en: To live long enough to give yourself up bare / to someone, in a hide without armour.
candidates.why: A sleeping back without armour, offered to the light.

slots.feeling: the other self undressing; longing as a seducer

candidates.source_quote: Ну же, с плеч приспусти бретели... / Ради Бога, не будь хладнокровна, / Убивая меня в постели!
candidates.gist_en: Come, let the straps slip from your shoulders... / For God's sake, don't be cold-blooded / while killing me in bed!
candidates.why: Longing personified slipping a strap: the reflection does what the body won't.

candidates.source_quote: You know how it is - sometimes the masterpiece hides in the mirror.
candidates.why: The mirror holds a daylight paradise the red room does not.

candidates.source_quote: It remains in the gap / between what is / and what the artist decided to see.
candidates.why: The gap between the still woman and her moving reflection.

slots.feeling: arrival as possession, a woman priced

candidates.source_quote: He holds her waist like she's another lot with a pre-sale estimate.
candidates.why: His flat palm on her waist, read as an auction appraisal.

candidates.source_quote: Что ж, будешь гостем этой осенью / В Моей Стране.
candidates.gist_en: Well then, you'll be a guest this autumn / in My Country.
candidates.why: Kira's cold welcome to the intruders landing on her island.

candidates.source_quote: It's about power. Owning what no one else can buy.
candidates.why: Names the collector's appetite walking toward us.

slots.feeling: recognising a captive's pain, cold watching

candidates.source_quote: Kira stands slightly behind, watching. / Knows this pain by name. / Knows how it smells in the morning.
candidates.why: Kira in front, the tightening grip behind: she knows this pain by its smell.

candidates.source_quote: Living round the clock with the Beast in a cage, other beasts outside didn't scare her.
candidates.why: Her steady gaze toward a predator: she has faced a worse beast.

candidates.source_quote: Продаешься, я - не продаюсь.
candidates.gist_en: You sell yourself; I am not for sale.
candidates.why: The bought woman behind, the unbought one in front.

slots.feeling: defiant entrance through a storm

candidates.source_quote: Kira, baby, I hear your storm inside louder than the one coming outside.
candidates.why: She walks into the storm carrying a louder one inside.

candidates.source_quote: Застегнувшись с запАхом, / Шла Душа с Карнавала.
candidates.gist_en: Buttoned up and wrapped tight, / the Soul walked home from the Carnival.
candidates.why: A soul walking out of the carnival, unhurried, eyes forward.

candidates.source_quote: Front row applauded. / Nobody knew she was dying inside.
candidates.why: The runway walk: applause outside, dying inside.

slots.feeling: adorned and bought, poise under lightning

candidates.source_quote: Light breaks against silk, runs over skin like Renoir's brush in The Bathers. / Each touch commits to the body. No rollback.
candidates.why: Rain-light running over her skin like a brush; every touch binding.

candidates.source_quote: Ты - фартовый. Ходи тузами. / Я - врагами. Пускай не мешают.
candidates.gist_en: You're the lucky one. Lead with aces. / I lead with enemies. Let them stay out of my way.
candidates.why: The power game of the necklace: his luck, her enemies.

candidates.source_quote: Addiction like a fat stain on silk lingerie.
candidates.why: Luxury with a stain under it; the sober woman inside the glamour.

slots.feeling: a mask cracking under appraisal

candidates.source_quote: Slowly killing the canvas from inside. Beauty with a self-destruct timer.
candidates.why: The craquelure by her eye: beauty cracking like old varnish.

candidates.source_quote: M. — mask too tight, cracks by the eyes.
candidates.why: Ule's note on Mila, exactly the crack at the corner of her eye.

candidates.source_quote: Too fragile for this industry, / but stubbornly alive.
candidates.why: A fragile model under a collector's gaze, still alive.

slots.feeling: slipping away, his hand closing on air

candidates.source_quote: Уходит и Она / Без Веры и Надежды / Излюблена до Дна.
candidates.gist_en: She leaves too, / without Faith or Hope, / loved down to the dregs.
candidates.why: Mila rising and going: used up, and leaving anyway.

candidates.source_quote: Зря ты поломал мои крючки. Рыбы не кончают суицидом.
candidates.gist_en: You broke my hooks for nothing. Fish don't commit suicide.
candidates.why: His grasp misses: the catch slips the hook.

candidates.source_quote: И гнутся, разгораясь, звезды / К нагой земле.
candidates.gist_en: And the stars bend, flaring, / toward the naked earth.
candidates.why: First stars over the black sand as she rises.

slots.feeling: a woman fading in and out like a reflection

candidates.source_quote: On an island where time flows like molasses, the hour of disappearance is always now — between sunset and first star, when shadows grow longer than memory.
candidates.why: The woman in the window flickering out: the hour of disappearance is always now.

candidates.source_quote: Somewhere beyond the window the ocean breathes ultramarine that wasn't on the impressionists' palette — too expensive, too pure, undiluted by turpentine.
candidates.why: The ultramarine night sea beyond the glass, a colour no palette held.

candidates.source_quote: Век свечи, чтоб скорей растопиться, / Растекается в вязком моменте.
candidates.gist_en: A candle's lifetime, hurrying to melt, / spills out into a viscous moment.
candidates.why: The candle flicker that makes her breathe in and out of being.

slots.feeling: a stare-down with the beast, sober vigilance

candidates.source_quote: Kira had to build a comfortable cage for two, step inside, sit down across from Him and look Him in the eyes.
candidates.why: The cage, the two chairs, the unblinking stare: her sobriety in one sentence.

candidates.source_quote: Without blinking. And when she wants to blink or sleep – she props them open with matches.
candidates.why: The burning match held at her open eye.

candidates.source_quote: Так давно не плавилась душонка / У прямого, ясного огня.
candidates.gist_en: It's been so long since my little soul melted / at a straight, clear flame.
candidates.why: The single match flame and what it melts in her.

slots.feeling: being fastened, a gift that binds

candidates.source_quote: One day pearl stems will wrap around you whole. / Like rings on fingers – nectars of their sweet resin.
candidates.why: Jewels closing around the neck as something that will wrap her whole.

candidates.source_quote: Как ты, висячая, на мне, / Выдергивала нити из под кожи,
candidates.gist_en: How you, hanging on me, / pulled threads from under my skin.
candidates.why: The necklace hanging on her, pulling at the skin.

candidates.source_quote: В моей железной нежности.
candidates.gist_en: In my iron tenderness.
candidates.why: His precise fingers on the metal clasp: tenderness made of iron.

slots.feeling: exposed noon stillness, the island's indifference

candidates.source_quote: Not blue. It's turquoise mixed with morphine — the turquoise of morphine dreams, when pain retreats but clarity stays sharp as a blade.
candidates.why: The hard white noon and trembling air: pain withdrawn, clarity like a blade.

candidates.source_quote: Locals say the island chooses who to keep. Spits out the rest.
candidates.why: A lone woman on an empty beach, waiting to see if she is kept.

candidates.source_quote: Unknown how many hours Kira spent there, in the embrace of that very polyphony of silence.
candidates.why: Her stillness on the sand as the island's silence.

slots.feeling: reading forbidden words carved in warm wood

candidates.source_quote: Words that could never be printed. / Words that still haven’t been forgiven.
candidates.why: Her fingertips in Gauguin's grooves: the unprintable carving.

candidates.source_quote: The wood was warm — like a memory card storing someone else's temperature.
candidates.why: The honeyed wood holding another's warmth under her touch.

candidates.source_quote: Мойры шарят по окнам, / Пряжу ткут в занавесках,
candidates.gist_en: The Fates rummage along the windows, / weaving yarn into the curtains.
candidates.why: The breathing curtains behind her as the Fates at work.

slots.feeling: life and code running in a cold vein

candidates.source_quote: Like the keyboard of Cursor at three in the morning when code is no longer code but the continuation of a vein.
candidates.why: Code composited along her vein: her own line for exactly that.

candidates.source_quote: Так пустить бы по венам жар... / Но все плещется полутьма... / Ты - наверное - Божий дар. / Я - наверное - "Я сама".
candidates.gist_en: If only heat could run through my veins... / but the half-dark keeps lapping... / You are, perhaps, a gift from God. / I am, perhaps, 'I'll do it myself.'
candidates.why: Cold blue light on the vein, longing for heat, and her stubborn self-reliance.

candidates.source_quote: When the soul is distributed — between servers, markets, and memory.
candidates.why: The soul spread through a pulse, like the code along the vein.

slots.feeling: cold calm in a feeding frenzy; the price in blood

candidates.source_quote: Every bid will be visible as blood on snow.
candidates.why: The crimson spreading over the white paddles: her exact image.

candidates.source_quote: Фасады лопнули. / В надрыве стены. / Мы дружно хлопали, Вскрывая вены,
candidates.gist_en: The facades burst. / The walls are torn. / All together we applauded, slitting our veins.
candidates.why: The applauding room as collective bleeding.

candidates.source_quote: Pastorales is consensus between those who understand: immortality costs exactly what you're willing to pay for someone else's agony.
candidates.why: The auction as a market in someone else's agony.

slots.feeling: a painting surfacing in the wall

candidates.source_quote: But today the paint refuses to stay inside its lines.
candidates.why: Gauguin's colours seeping up through the stains of the plaster.

candidates.source_quote: Я тебя не найду: страждет холст под невзрачною маской...
candidates.gist_en: I will not find you: a canvas suffers under a drab mask...
candidates.why: The painting hidden under the plaster, beneath his hand.

candidates.source_quote: An honest attempt to recreate what never was.
candidates.why: The fresco that surfaces and sinks back: what never was.

slots.feeling: a secret found and hidden

candidates.source_quote: В животе засосало. Не от голода — от узнавания.
candidates.gist_en: Her stomach clenched. Not from hunger, from recognition.
candidates.why: Finding the swollen notebook: recognition, not discovery.

candidates.source_quote: Сейчас — только тяжесть секрета под рёбрами.
candidates.gist_en: Now, only the weight of a secret under the ribs.
candidates.why: Drawing it out of the light, she keeps it to herself.

candidates.source_quote: You'll find what you're looking for. But it won't be what you expect.
candidates.why: The find that is not the painting she hunted.

slots.feeling: an unanswered night, solitude at the window

candidates.source_quote: Kira, the rains have long burned my dreams with ice...
candidates.why: Ule at the rain window: his own line about rain and frozen dreams.

candidates.source_quote: Night did not ask permission. / It simply stopped pretending.
candidates.why: Night at the open casement, no longer pretending.

candidates.source_quote: And Nobody up there hears you anymore.
candidates.why: Far lights smearing on the bay, nobody listening.

slots.feeling: a hard man cracking, one tear

candidates.source_quote: "Не заплачу никогда...", / Но слеза вдруг до упора / Жмет на тормоз разговора / Струйкой стаявшего льда.
candidates.gist_en: 'I'll never cry...' / but a tear suddenly presses / the brake on the conversation all the way, / a trickle of melted ice.
candidates.why: From her poem 'Men Don't Cry': one tear, and the melting-ice shimmer on his cheek.

candidates.source_quote: Like the desert learned to cry flowers despite itself.
candidates.why: A dry, hard face that learned to cry despite itself.

candidates.source_quote: Just data streaming down the face. Salt water returning to the ocean.
candidates.why: His tear, no sobbing, running down the old trail.

slots.feeling: reading his grief like a map

candidates.source_quote: Ule wiped his face. Salt left white trails on his skin — like maps of countries that don't exist.
candidates.why: Her fingertip on the salt trail: maps of countries that don't exist.

candidates.source_quote: Renoir in his last years painted with brushes tied to his arthritis-twisted fingers. / Pain didn't leave — it became part of the light.
candidates.why: Pain kept and turned into light, like the crimson pulsing over the skin.

candidates.source_quote: И ни со зла, и никак. / Просто некая точность - / Словно старый наждак, / Мне истерший кожу.
candidates.gist_en: Not out of malice, not anyhow. / Just a certain precision, / like old sandpaper / that has worn my skin away.
candidates.why: The salt line read with precision: grief that wears the skin.

slots.feeling: two witnesses held in moonlight; recognition

candidates.source_quote: Palm still on Ule’s chest. / Under the skin — steady pulse. / Not consensus. / Just proof that the chain still holds.
candidates.why: Her palm on his chest, the pulse at his throat: proof, not romance.

candidates.source_quote: Moonlight from the Maison du Jouir window falls across his chest exactly along the lines Gauguin once carved into the lintel.
candidates.why: The carved moonlight lace lying across his chest.

candidates.source_quote: Эта дикая пустошь в твоих глазах есть Простой Абсолют.
candidates.gist_en: This wild wasteland in your eyes is a Simple Absolute.
candidates.why: Both gazes on the lens, a wasteland in the eyes.

slots.feeling: being known by an old wound

candidates.source_quote: Not down. / Not up. / Exactly along the line where in childhood in Moscow they gave her injections because her mother was afraid the daughter was “growing wrong.”
candidates.why: His fingertip along the scar, and the childhood wound it came from.

candidates.source_quote: Paradise is when pain stops pretending to be accidental.
candidates.why: The pale scar as pain that no longer pretends to be an accident.

candidates.source_quote: The road to Atuona isn't a road. It's a scar on the island's body that refuses to heal.
candidates.why: The scar on her back echoed by the island's own scar.

slots.feeling: words that must not be spoken

candidates.source_quote: Kira puts two fingers on his lips. / To feel the words born straight from the body.
candidates.why: Two fingers on his moving lips, feeling the words before they sound.

candidates.source_quote: silence is not the absence of sound. / It is when both know what to say and choose not to.
candidates.why: The contract's silence in her own definition.

candidates.source_quote: Ржавые мифы по лезвию. / Тупится новая бритва. / Сродни с ума сошествию / Моим губам молитва.
candidates.gist_en: Rusty myths along the blade. / The new razor is going dull. / Like going out of my mind, / a prayer on my lips.
candidates.why: A prayer held on lips that cannot speak it.

slots.feeling: a name breathed like a password

candidates.source_quote: Ule. / This time there is no question in his name. / Only consensus.
candidates.why: The one name in the film, voiced off-face, as agreement rather than question.

candidates.source_quote: Я - та иная Прохлада, / Что на твоем пути.
candidates.gist_en: I am that other Coolness / that lies across your path.
candidates.why: The cool lilac-white light where her breath falls on his throat.

candidates.source_quote: Будто бы в преисподней ждет нас один пароль.
candidates.gist_en: As if in the underworld a single password waits for us.
candidates.why: His name as the password between them.

slots.feeling: a reach frozen in the air; restraint

candidates.source_quote: Ule does not kiss. / He looks.
candidates.why: His hand stopped at her jaw: no kiss, only looking.

candidates.source_quote: Но раз встав на колени, / Ты навеки разодран.
candidates.gist_en: But once you have gone down on your knees, / you are torn apart forever.
candidates.why: Ule kneeling, his hand stopped in the air.

candidates.source_quote: Not from pleasure. / From recognition.
candidates.why: The film's law: recognition, not seduction.

slots.feeling: truth at the pulse

candidates.source_quote: Where it is no longer possible to lie to yourself.
candidates.why: Her palm pressed to his throat, where lying is no longer possible.

candidates.source_quote: Тут Сердце - Театр без зрителей.
candidates.gist_en: Here the Heart is a theatre without an audience.
candidates.why: The empty salon behind, a heart beating for no audience.

candidates.source_quote: Something that must hold weight.
candidates.why: The pressed palm that holds.

slots.feeling: witness, not lover; dawn after the storm

candidates.source_quote: Ule places his palm on the small of her back. / Not a lover. A witness.
candidates.why: His palm on the small of her back, and her own line saying what it is: not a lover.

candidates.source_quote: a red dog. / Fact: dogs aren't red. / Fact: it has no shadow.
candidates.why: The red dog that casts no shadow, as she wrote it from Arearea.

candidates.source_quote: Может встретимся, статься, однажды, / Перекурим в лиловый рассвет,
candidates.gist_en: Maybe we'll meet someday, who knows, / and smoke into the lilac dawn,
candidates.why: The lilac dawn they stand in, two who stay apart.

slots.feeling: two selves, a fork

candidates.source_quote: Both things are happening at once.
candidates.why: Two versions of the same woman, at once.

candidates.source_quote: The one who was supposed to die instead of you.
candidates.why: One of the two is the woman who should have died.

candidates.source_quote: Time no longer flows. / It branches.
candidates.why: Her life forking into two branches on the sand.

slots.feeling: walking out of the ring whole: nobody's wife

candidates.source_quote: Закольцуешься чьим-то мужем. / Я останусь: ничьей женой, / Атуоной, горбатой старушкой / В целом с Богом и чуть - с Сатаной.
candidates.gist_en: You'll loop yourself into being someone's husband. / I will remain: nobody's wife, / Atuona, a hunched old woman, / on the whole with God, and a little with Satan.
candidates.why: She steps out of the closed ring ('loop yourself' is a ring verb in Russian): nobody's wife, Atuona.

candidates.source_quote: Atuona is a state of being. When you stop running FROM and start running TO.
candidates.why: Walking toward us, unhurried: at last running to.

candidates.source_quote: The earth still held yesterday's rain — moisture seeped black between her toes like printer's ink.
candidates.why: Bare feet on wet black sand, her story still being printed.

slots.feeling: the sea breathing; erasure and return

candidates.source_quote: More like — allowance. That tomorrow will happen, and you'll be in it.
candidates.why: The last foam slides back and the sand gleams again: allowance.

candidates.source_quote: Outside the Pacific breathed its ancient rhythm — inhale, exhale, without emphasis.
candidates.why: The sheet of foam coming in and drawing back, without emphasis.

candidates.source_quote: Все закончится одиночеством. / Снова. / И с него же начнется.
candidates.gist_en: Everything will end in loneliness. / Again. / And begin from it, too.
candidates.why: An empty beach where the end and the beginning are one wave.

slots.feeling: cold distance; a contract of silence across a lit void

candidates.source_quote: and now the silence is so complete / it could swallow a scream whole / and ask for more.
candidates.why: Opens the long poem on its law: a silence total enough to swallow a scream, over two still bodies at opposite ends of an empty gallery (her Turbine Hall passage). It returns at 28 (silence defined) and 32 (no more lying).

candidates.source_quote: Холодные пустыни теплых чувств. / Ты плюнул - я ответила: Научусь.
candidates.gist_en: Cold deserts of warm feelings. You spat; I answered: I'll learn.
candidates.why: The film's thesis in one aphorism: a cold contract with warm feeling held at a distance, and 'I'll learn' is her accepting the terms. From 'Nobody's', which rhymes with 'nobody's wife' at 36.

candidates.source_quote: Мне тебя не обнять, я на нижней земле, ты на верхней, нет места в твоем Королевстве,
candidates.gist_en: I can't hold you: I'm on the lower ground, you're on the upper; there is no room in your Kingdom.
candidates.why: Two figures who cannot cross the floor between them. The refused Kingdom is answered at 25 if her 'guest in My Country' (#042) is used there. Note: #006 is rank 1 at 1b.

slots.feeling: almost-touch; heat across a gap that never closes

candidates.source_quote: Здравствуй, друг, мне бы к тебе прикоснуться легонько, чуть-чуть, / Но так дорого стоит это тепло, выше всяких валют,
candidates.gist_en: Hello, friend, I'd like to touch you, lightly, just barely, but this warmth costs so much, more than any currency.
candidates.why: Exactly the breath that never becomes a touch, addressed to a 'friend', not a lover. It prices the warmth the way the contract does, starting a money thread that returns at 14 and 20.

candidates.source_quote: He does not touch her. He simply stands close enough that she feels the heat of his body through the fabric.
candidates.why: Literal and exact for the macro: heat through tweed, no contact; recognition, not seduction. Note: #097 is rank 1 at 19 and 34.

candidates.source_quote: Ambrette and Jamaican pepper / don't warm — / only promise heat.
candidates.why: Scent as a promise that never pays out: the heat-haze in the gap told as perfume notes. Short, sensual, unromantic.

slots.feeling: longing with no one to kiss; ice that melts and freezes back

candidates.source_quote: Поцелуя не жду. Губами / Расцелую я лед на стеклах.
candidates.gist_en: I don't wait for a kiss. With my lips I'll cover the ice on the panes with kisses.
candidates.why: Her own image of this exact gesture: pride and longing, the kiss given to cold glass and her own reflection. The ice comes back melted as Ule's tear at 24.

candidates.source_quote: Сродни с ума сошествию / Моим губам молитва.
candidates.gist_en: Akin to going out of one's mind: a prayer on my lips.
candidates.why: Lips on frosted glass with eyes closed, like a near-mad prayer. Short and sharp.

candidates.source_quote: The thaw at the end of January had behaved deceitfully, as usual.
candidates.why: The clear oval melts and the frost creeps back: a thaw that lies. Cold and wry, and it plants the lie that comes at 22.

slots.feeling: a burnt soul lifting off; grace in burning out

candidates.source_quote: И листья вальсировать будут порознь. / А мне - благодать. Догорать. Догорать.
candidates.gist_en: And the leaves will waltz apart. And for me, grace. To burn down. To burn down.
candidates.why: One ember-veined leaf parting from everything: 'Last Autumn' makes the rise a calm, defiant burning-out. The match at 15 answers it ('burn without burning down', if #031 is chosen there).

candidates.source_quote: Несвоевременные радости, / Жги, малыш, то, что осталось нам.
candidates.gist_en: Untimely joys: burn, baby, whatever we have left.
candidates.why: Reckless and tender at once: the leaf is what is left, and it burns.

candidates.source_quote: Рябины зябнущие грозди. / Закат в золе.
candidates.gist_en: Shivering clusters of rowan. Sunset in ash.
candidates.why: Pure image, ember-red against a storm sky; cold and burnt in very few words.

slots.feeling: surrender by choice; going under into cool silence

candidates.source_quote: One day I'll drown / In cool silence / And drift to sleep.
candidates.why: Kira's own verse in the novel. Her unblinking gaze, then the slip under, is this exact wish without fear, and 'cool silence' carries the contract into the sea.

candidates.source_quote: "Я люблю" - шум немой реки, / Дважды топящей всех готовых.
candidates.gist_en: 'I love' is the noise of a mute river that drowns, twice, everyone who is ready.
candidates.why: Love as dark water that takes the willing. Sharp and fatal, matched to the black sea closing over her face.

candidates.source_quote: Art is an ocean where people drown trying to save themselves, but it's hopeless.
candidates.why: Ule's creed from the flight, drowning as the only way to feel art, ties the sea to the hunt. Note: #055 is rank 1 at 22.

slots.feeling: rising with borrowed wings; fragile rebirth

candidates.source_quote: Я тебя крылатая, дождусь, / перьями подушку набиваю.
candidates.gist_en: Winged, I will wait for you, stuffing the pillow with feathers.
candidates.why: Three wet feathers where wings would be: waiting, half-flown. Its second half lands on the scales at 7, so the two shots read as one stanza.

candidates.source_quote: Salt from yesterday's tears, today's sweat. / All the same ocean.
candidates.why: Water streaming off her shoulder blade, grief and heat dissolved into one sea; plants the salt that becomes his tear-trails at 25. Note: #078 is rank 1 at 10a and 10b.

candidates.source_quote: Дожить, чтоб наголо отдаться / Кому-то в шкуре без брони.
candidates.gist_en: To live long enough to give yourself up, bare, to someone, in a skin with no armour.
candidates.why: A bare back with no armour: vulnerability as the price of rising from the water.

slots.feeling: a shed self on the sand; the trace of someone gone

candidates.source_quote: Зря ты снова сбросил чешую / там, где я тихонечко взлетаю.
candidates.gist_en: In vain you've shed your scales again, right where I am quietly taking wing.
candidates.why: The scales lie just where she rose, his old skin left behind as she lifts. It completes the 7m stanza.

candidates.source_quote: She doesn’t speak in manifestos. / She leaves traces.
candidates.why: A footprint holding the moon and a heap of scales: no statement, only traces. Quiet, defiant, standalone. Note: #095 is rank 1 at 1a and 18.

candidates.source_quote: Снова твои следы высохли без воды. / Впитались слезы в стекло.
candidates.gist_en: Again your footprints have dried without water. Tears have soaked into the glass.
candidates.why: Footprint and absence; 'tears soaked into glass' reaches back to the frost kiss at 2.

slots.feeling: senses waking; scent before light

candidates.source_quote: Morning in Atuona doesn't begin with light. / It begins with scent.
candidates.why: Exactly what the frame does: one deep breath, steam tinted like frangipani, morning arriving through the nose.

candidates.source_quote: The air smelled not of tropical flowers — it smelled of time.
candidates.why: Turns the visible scent into something older and stranger: the other reality felt through the air she breathes.

candidates.source_quote: ATUONA breathes deep, like the ocean before sunset.
candidates.why: The island breathing with her; short and calm, it puts the place's name inside the breath.

slots.feeling: slow heat; light touching skin like honey

candidates.source_quote: Sheets stuck to skin like a second dress. / Through the shutters — Atuona morning, thick as honey. / The air tastes of frangipani and rust.
candidates.why: Honey through the shutters, skin, heat, the taste of air: the frame in her own words, sensual without one explicit word, and 'rust' keeps it underground.

candidates.source_quote: Ну же, зайчата, скорей / Прыгайте в рваный рюкзак, / С вами за столько морей / Светлее чужбины мрак.
candidates.gist_en: Come on, little sun-flecks, quick, jump into the torn backpack; with you, across so many seas, the dark of a foreign land is lighter.
candidates.why: Sun-flecks as small companions in exile: the light warming a fugitive's shoulder far from home. Tender and specific.

candidates.source_quote: Сладких снов недосмотренных стая / Все кружит, приземляясь на лицах...
candidates.gist_en: A flock of sweet, unfinished dreams keeps circling, landing on faces...
candidates.why: The gold dust motes turning in the beam become half-watched dreams settling on her half-open eyes.

slots.feeling: skin answering the air; tenderness

candidates.source_quote: Skin meets air like first kiss.
candidates.why: The fine hairs lift gold in the light: the body's first kiss, answering the kiss refused on glass at 2.

candidates.source_quote: The body stays. / The light moves.
candidates.why: The film's law, said where it is most literally true: she does not move, the honey stripe does.

candidates.source_quote: But for now – it's beautiful.
candidates.why: A small, fragile mercy before the storm; quiet enough for a four-second hold.

slots.feeling: the double; a reflection that dares what she will not

candidates.source_quote: Что, сползая до нитки, не голая, / Не сердечная и не вгревшая / Ни тепла и ни вечного холода, / Остаюсь я навеки застывшая.
candidates.gist_en: Slipping down to the last thread, yet not naked; neither warm-hearted nor ever warmed by heat or by eternal cold, I stay frozen forever.
candidates.why: The strap slips in the mirror, the silk never falls, the woman in the room stays frozen: one stanza describes both women at once, never explicit.

candidates.source_quote: Что ж так рвешься в мой плен суровый? / Ну же, с плеч приспусти бретели... / Ради Бога, не будь хладнокровна, / Убивая меня в постели!
candidates.gist_en: Why do you strain so into my harsh captivity? Come on, slip the straps down off your shoulders... For God's sake, don't be cold-blooded, killing me in bed!
candidates.why: Literally the strap. In her poem it is Longing who is undressed, which suits a reflection with a will of its own. Sits at the 30-word maximum.

candidates.source_quote: You know how it is - sometimes the masterpiece hides in the mirror.
candidates.why: Lighter and sly: the painting they hunt is the woman in the glass. It plants the 'two versions' of 35.

slots.feeling: ownership on display; glamour as possession

candidates.source_quote: He holds her waist like she's another lot with a pre-sale estimate.
candidates.why: The flat palm on her waist as an auction estimate: cold and exact, it brings the market onto the jetty.

candidates.source_quote: Я вижу, как ты крутишься, душа, / Пока Господь тебя благорассудит.
candidates.gist_en: I see you spinning, soul, while God makes up His mind about you.
candidates.why: From her runway poem: a model turning under judgement, seen from Kira's shoulder.

candidates.source_quote: Сложное было детство. / Сложнее — семейное счастье.
candidates.gist_en: Childhood was hard. Harder still: family happiness.
candidates.why: Wry and cutting about the engaged couple's entrance; short enough for the five-second shot.

slots.feeling: recognising a captive; a watcher who knows this pain

candidates.source_quote: Knows this pain by name. / Knows how it smells in the morning.
candidates.why: Kira's lit eyes in front, the tightening wrist-grip behind: she recognises captivity because she has lived it. Her addiction thread surfaces again at 15.

candidates.source_quote: Living round the clock with the Beast in a cage, other beasts outside didn't scare her.
candidates.why: Turns her stillness into strength facing the predator, and foreshadows the cage at 15.

candidates.source_quote: Я тихонько молчу, улыбаючись, / Сберегаю свои красноречия.
candidates.gist_en: I keep quietly silent, smiling, saving up my eloquence.
candidates.why: Mila's poised smile and Kira's held gaze in one line: silence as a weapon both women use.

slots.feeling: power walking into the storm; entrance as defiance

candidates.source_quote: Kira, baby, I hear your storm inside louder than the one coming outside.
candidates.why: The frame shows the outer storm; the line names the louder one inside her as she walks, eyes on the lens.

candidates.source_quote: Навещу-ка ублюдков / Я непрошеным гостем,
candidates.gist_en: I think I'll drop in on the bastards as an uninvited guest,
candidates.why: Swagger at exactly target length; her profanity used once, as an entrance.

candidates.source_quote: Застегнувшись с запАхом, / Шла Душа с Карнавала.
candidates.gist_en: Buttoned up, wrapped tight across, the Soul walked from the Carnival.
candidates.why: A walk with dignity through chaos; plants the carnival of masks that cracks at M3.

slots.feeling: adorned and bought; a clasp that seals the contract

candidates.source_quote: Light breaks against silk, runs over skin like Renoir's brush in The Bathers. / Each touch commits to the body. No rollback.
candidates.why: Rain-light runs over her skin like brushwork and the clasp closes: every touch commits, no rollback. Transaction and painting in one.

candidates.source_quote: Эти смыслы навечно срослись - эротика и активы, / Их - под лютый конвой - они целы и невредимы.
candidates.gist_en: These meanings have fused forever: erotica and assets. Put them under fierce escort, and they stay whole and unharmed.
candidates.why: The necklace as an advance on the contract: desire and money welded, her composure 'whole and unharmed' under his hands. Note: #094 is rank 1 at 5.

candidates.source_quote: Я давно не люблю на сдачу. / Просто сдачу за три рубля.
candidates.gist_en: I stopped loving for small change long ago. Just change, three roubles' worth.
candidates.why: A bitter counter-voice to the diamonds: she won't be paid in change. It cuts the glamour.

slots.feeling: a mask cracking; beauty as a damaged canvas

candidates.source_quote: Slowly killing the canvas from inside. Beauty with a self-destruct timer.
candidates.why: The craquelure at Mila's eye as varnish failing on a masterpiece: her line for paint that destroys itself.

candidates.source_quote: M. — mask too tight, cracks by the eyes.
candidates.why: Ule's note on Mila, literal to the frame; short and clinical. Note: #085 is rank 1 at M5.

candidates.source_quote: Фасады лопнули. / В надрыве стены.
candidates.gist_en: The facades have burst. The walls are strained to tearing.
candidates.why: Two blunt lines: the façade of a face giving way.

slots.feeling: slipping out of a grip; a hand closing on air

candidates.source_quote: Ты как-то, детка, не случалась... / Случись теперь из западни.
candidates.gist_en: Somehow, baby, you never quite happened... Happen now, out of the trap.
candidates.why: Mila rising and leaving her colour behind while his hand closes on nothing: an escape spoken as a blessing.

candidates.source_quote: И гнутся, разгораясь, звезды / К нагой земле.
candidates.gist_en: And the stars, flaring up, bend down to the naked earth.
candidates.why: The first stars above, ultramarine dust settling on black sand: beauty falling to earth as it slips away.

candidates.source_quote: Too fragile for this industry, / but stubbornly alive.
candidates.why: The model who walks out of his reach: fragile, unbought, alive.

slots.feeling: a woman fading like a reflection; absence

candidates.source_quote: Mila caught his gaze and smiled slightly — that smile people wear when they've already decided on their own disappearance.
candidates.why: The woman in the window breathing in and out of transparency: the smile of someone who has already chosen to vanish.

candidates.source_quote: Век свечи, чтоб скорей растопиться, / Растекается в вязком моменте.
candidates.gist_en: A candle's lifetime, hurrying to melt, spreads out into a viscous moment.
candidates.why: Built on the candle whose flicker makes her appear and fade: time melting, a moment that won't hold.

candidates.source_quote: Somewhere beyond the window the ocean breathes ultramarine that wasn't on the impressionists' palette — too expensive, too pure, undiluted by turpentine.
candidates.why: The ultramarine night sea beyond the glass, a colour too pure to buy; an exact match for the background.

slots.feeling: vigilance; staring down the Beast in a cage for two

candidates.source_quote: Kira had to build a comfortable cage for two, step inside, sit down across from Him and look Him in the eyes.
candidates.why: The cage, the two facing chairs, eyes that must not close: her sobriety image, with the Beast as the true opponent, not Ule. At target length.

candidates.source_quote: Убегая, не прячусь я, / Мы от силы не прячемся, / Лишь горим, не сгораючи, / Лишь горючее плавится
candidates.gist_en: Running, I don't hide; we don't hide from strength; we only burn without burning down; only the fuel melts.
candidates.why: The match burns at her open eye and never shortens: 'burning without burning down'. Callback to the leaf's 'to burn down' at 5.

candidates.source_quote: Ты - не Авель, но и я - не Каин, / Вместе нам с тобой не заодно.
candidates.gist_en: You're not Abel, but I'm not Cain either; together, you and I are still not on one side.
candidates.why: A duel of stares between equals: no romance, no truce.

slots.feeling: a ritual asked for again; scent made visible

candidates.source_quote: Повторяя глотки Килиана / Из пригоршней Её волос, / Я Ей, миленький, так и не стану.
candidates.gist_en: Repeating sips of Kilian from handfuls of Her hair, I'll never become Her, darling.
candidates.why: Perfume shimmering as heat-haze over her shoulder. Kilian is Kira's scent in the novel, and 'Her' keeps Kira's desire pointed at women. From 'Atuona', the title poem, which closes the film at 36.

candidates.source_quote: Так давно не плавилась душонка / У прямого, ясного огня.
candidates.gist_en: It's been so long since my small soul melted by a straight, clear fire.
candidates.why: Emerald light like sea water and warmth returning to the skin; small, tender, unsentimental.

candidates.source_quote: Fashion is body language we choose each morning. But what if the body itself becomes canvas?
candidates.why: The necklace on wet skin, light moving like paint: the body becomes the canvas, which is the motif of the film's second half.

slots.feeling: glare and solitude; seeing what isn't there

candidates.source_quote: Pink sand that never existed. / Horses that were never on Hiva Oa. / Everything invented.
candidates.why: Black sand at hard noon and a figure to be composited in: her line on Gauguin's invented beach makes the unreal arrival felt before it is seen.

candidates.source_quote: Fact: dogs aren't red. / Fact: it has no shadow. / Fact: Gauguin never explained its meaning.
candidates.why: If the composite is the red dog: her flat, strange declaration of the shadowless dog, exact to the plate.

candidates.source_quote: Here the sun stops you, suddenly spilling shamelessly across your face and palms.
candidates.why: From her glossy column, raw sun that halts you: she lifts her eyes into the glare and stops.

slots.feeling: touching what can't be forgiven; history under the fingertips

candidates.source_quote: Words that could never be printed. / Words that still haven’t been forgiven.
candidates.why: Her fingers in the grooves: Gauguin's insults cut into the wood and still unforgiven. Exact length.

candidates.source_quote: The wood was warm — like a memory card storing someone else's temperature.
candidates.why: Wood warm with someone else's heat: the honey sunbeam as stored body warmth.

candidates.source_quote: the most immortal works are born from the most mortal among us.
candidates.why: An aphorism for the carving: immortal work by mortal hands.

slots.feeling: the vein as a line of script; a pulse under cold light

candidates.source_quote: Like the keyboard of Cursor at three in the morning when code is no longer code but the continuation of a vein.
candidates.why: Code composited along the vein: 'no longer code but the continuation of a vein' is the shot itself, making her code her blood.

candidates.source_quote: Так пустить бы по венам жар... / Но все плещется полутьма...
candidates.gist_en: If only heat could be sent running through the veins... but the half-dark keeps splashing...
candidates.why: Cold blue-white light sliding along the vein: longing for heat, getting dusk.

candidates.source_quote: Under the skin — steady pulse. / Not consensus. / Just proof that the chain still holds.
candidates.why: The faint pulse at the wrist under the composited code: life as the chain that still holds. Note: #096 is rank 1 at 32.

slots.feeling: a market of fear; red ink spreading in snow

candidates.source_quote: Fear of losing, fear of overpaying, fear of missing out. Collectors clutch their paddles like life preservers.
candidates.why: Paddles drifting like a tide, everyone gripping theirs: fear made visible, while she alone sits still.

candidates.source_quote: Every bid will be visible as blood on snow.
candidates.why: Crimson spreading over white paddles is this exact image; Kira's prophecy for Pastorales.

candidates.source_quote: Impressionists died poor. / Dealers built names on their mistakes.
candidates.why: The cold arithmetic behind the bidding room; short and damning.

slots.feeling: a painting buried in the walls; colour surfacing and sinking
