candidates.source_quote: Я тебя не найду: страждет холст под невзрачною маской...
candidates.gist_en: I will not find you: the canvas is suffering under a drab mask...
candidates.why: Gauguin's colours bloom in the stained plaster, then sink: a canvas under a mask, and a search that won't end in finding. The mask echoes M3.

candidates.source_quote: But today the paint refuses to stay inside its lines.
candidates.why: Colour leaking through plaster and refusing its borders; sharp and standalone. Note: #097 is rank 1 at 19 and 34.

candidates.source_quote: He uses color not as description, / but as declaration.
candidates.why: Ochre, rose and deep green rising as a statement: Gauguin's method under Ule's palm.

slots.feeling: a secret claimed; the weight of knowing

candidates.source_quote: В животе засосало. Не от голода — от узнавания.
candidates.gist_en: Her stomach dropped. Not from hunger: from recognition.
candidates.why: From the notebook chapter itself, without the plot: the gut-drop of recognising what she holds. 'Recognition' is the word the film turns on at 26.

candidates.source_quote: Память куплена, / Но не продана -
candidates.gist_en: Memory: bought, but not sold.
candidates.why: The notebook as memory she will not sell, drawn out of the light. At target length, and it cuts against the auction at 20.

candidates.source_quote: Только все это - мелким почерком, / Водостоком в ливневки катится.
candidates.gist_en: Only all of it, in small handwriting, rolls down the drainpipe into the storm drains.
candidates.why: Small handwriting, rot and damp: the swollen notebook as everything that nearly washed away.

slots.feeling: loneliness at a rainy window; the lie hanging in the air

candidates.source_quote: Kira, the rains have long burned my dreams with ice...
candidates.why: Ule's own line over Ule alone in the rain: dreams burned with ice, linking back to the frost at 2.

candidates.source_quote: We manage to be liars in simple answers.
candidates.why: Right after her 'No. Nothing.': the lie named as a skill they share. Her own column line from the day she was hired.

candidates.source_quote: Только тихо безмолвствуя, / Жру свое одиночество.
candidates.gist_en: Only keeping quietly silent, I devour my loneliness.
candidates.why: Closed mouth, slow breath, nobody enters: silence as a meal of loneliness.

slots.feeling: a man's silent tears; ice melting

candidates.source_quote: "Не заплачу никогда...", / Но слеза вдруг до упора / Жмет на тормоз разговора / Струйкой стаявшего льда.
candidates.gist_en: 'I will never cry...', but a tear suddenly slams the brakes on the conversation, all the way, a trickle of thawed ice.
candidates.why: Her poem 'Men Don't Cry' on the single tear that wells: no sobbing, just thawed ice. It closes the frost-kiss circle from 2, at target length.

candidates.source_quote: Плачут ночные лисицы. / Слезы их мне знакомы.
candidates.gist_en: The night foxes are crying. I know their tears.
candidates.why: Wild animals weeping in the dark: recognition through tears, not pity.

candidates.source_quote: Like the desert learned to cry flowers despite itself.
candidates.why: Tears as a hard man's unlikely flowering; English and short.

slots.feeling: tenderness reading grief like a map

candidates.source_quote: Salt left white trails on his skin — like maps of countries that don't exist.
candidates.why: Her fingertip on the salt line: the map of countries that don't exist. Exact and luminous.

candidates.source_quote: Tender hands untouched by fatigue, / daily scars not yet stitched into warm cheeks.
candidates.why: From her oldest poem: a tender hand and scars not yet stitched into warm cheeks. Gentle and strange.

candidates.source_quote: Что ж, будешь гостем этой осенью / В Моей Стране.
candidates.gist_en: Well then, you will be a guest this autumn in My Country.
candidates.why: The map becomes her country, with him as its guest; it answers the refused Kingdom of 1a (#006) if both are used.

slots.feeling: recognition, not seduction; two damaged people seen

candidates.source_quote: It's the moment when someone sees through your careful construction straight to your trembling core.
candidates.why: Both faces open to the lens as moonlight lace drifts: being seen through to the trembling core is the film's 'recognition'.

candidates.source_quote: В этих ума изувечьях, / В этих безумствах чувств, / Мы же давно искалечены, / Но я к тебе вернусь.
candidates.gist_en: In these maimings of the mind, in these madnesses of feeling, we were crippled long ago, but I will come back to you.
candidates.why: Two damaged creators side by side, at target length; a return without romance. The same poem gives the password at 30.

candidates.source_quote: Эта дикая пустошь в твоих глазах есть Простой Абсолют.
candidates.gist_en: This wild wasteland in your eyes is a Simple Absolute.
candidates.why: Held gazes, no blinking: the emptiness in his eyes as something absolute. Echoes 1b's 'Hello, friend'. Note: #006 is rank 1 at 1b.

slots.feeling: an old wound found and seen; healed

candidates.source_quote: И ни со зла, и никак. / Просто некая точность - / Словно старый наждак, / Мне истерший кожу.
candidates.gist_en: Not out of malice, not in any way. Just a certain precision, like old sandpaper that has worn my skin away.
candidates.why: One fingertip tracing an old, pale line with precision: hurt without blame, long healed. Tactile and exact.

candidates.source_quote: Pain didn't leave — it became part of the light.
candidates.why: Honey light travelling across the scar: pain kept and turned into light.

candidates.source_quote: Ты прости. Я, наверное, лечена. / Не залечена до бессилия.
candidates.gist_en: Forgive me. I've been treated, I suppose, but not treated into helplessness.
candidates.why: A healed scar that is not a weakness; dry and proud.

slots.feeling: silence as speech; words that never sound

candidates.source_quote: silence is not the absence of sound. / It is when both know what to say and choose not to.
candidates.why: His lips forming words under her fingers that never sound: her definition of the film's silence, answering the swallowed scream of 1a. Non-explicit lines from #098.

candidates.source_quote: The words fall like failed bids, never reaching the floor.
candidates.why: Words that never land; calls back the auction at 20.

candidates.source_quote: На луну не полезем больше - / Нет там кайфов - / Только пахучий уж очень дымок от вчерашних слов.
candidates.gist_en: We won't climb to the moon any more; there's no high up there, only the very pungent smoke of yesterday's words.
candidates.why: Faint smoke drifting behind, and words reduced to the smoke of yesterday; wry and melancholy.

slots.feeling: a name as a password; the silence breaks

candidates.source_quote: Будто бы в преисподней ждет нас один пароль.
candidates.gist_en: As if, in the underworld, a single password waits for us.
candidates.why: His name breathed onto the lit throat: the one word that opens the door. The same poem as 26.

candidates.source_quote: This time there is no question in his name. / Only consensus.
candidates.why: His name said as certainty, not a plea. Note: #098 is rank 1 at 28.

candidates.source_quote: Some messages aren't notifications. / They're commits. / And once confirmed, / there's no rollback.
candidates.why: A word that cannot be taken back: once said, no rollback. Note: #068 is rank 1 at 9 and 17.

slots.feeling: the freeze; restraint at the edge

candidates.source_quote: Between compile and run / there's a second. / Pure. / Naked.
candidates.why: His hand stopped in the air at her jaw: the held second before anything happens. Her poetics for a near-still take.

candidates.source_quote: Но раз встав на колени, / Ты навеки разодран.
candidates.gist_en: But once you've gone down on your knees, you are torn apart forever.
candidates.why: He kneels and stops: the cost of kneeling, said without romance.

candidates.source_quote: Частушки, обеты, треп... / Воспользуюсь правилом "Стоп".
candidates.gist_en: Ditties, vows, idle talk... I'll invoke the rule of 'Stop'.
candidates.why: The stopped hand as a self-imposed rule; wry, and as binding as the contract.

slots.feeling: life beating under her palm; no more lying

candidates.source_quote: Where it is no longer possible to lie to yourself.
candidates.why: Her palm pressed to his pulse: the place where the lie of 22 cannot survive.

candidates.source_quote: Not a lullaby. / Not a song. / Allowance.
candidates.why: The pulse as the three-note cell: not a love song, but allowance. Note: #088 is rank 1 at 25.

candidates.source_quote: Ты - наверное - Божий дар. / Я - наверное - "Я сама".
candidates.gist_en: You are, probably, a gift from God. I am, probably, 'I'll do it myself'.
candidates.why: Two kinds of strength meeting at a pulse; equals, not lovers.

slots.feeling: stillness afterwards; a witness, not a lover; lilac peace

candidates.source_quote: Ule places his palm on the small of her back. / Not a lover. A witness.
candidates.why: The palm on the small of her back as in the frame, with the film's rule spelled out: not a lover, a witness.

candidates.source_quote: Может встретимся, статься, однажды, / Перекурим в лиловый рассвет,
candidates.gist_en: Maybe, as it happens, we'll meet one day and smoke together into the lilac dawn,
candidates.why: Exactly the lilac dawn, two people side by side with nothing more than companionship. Note: #003 is rank 1 at 16b and 36, so use at most two of the three.

candidates.source_quote: Нету лучше собаки на свете. / Звонко лаяла, молча любя.
candidates.gist_en: There's no better dog in the world. She barked out loud and loved in silence.
candidates.why: The red dog sitting still between them, and love that stays silent: the contract of silence turned into tenderness.

slots.feeling: the fork; one woman split in two

candidates.source_quote: Two versions of the same woman.
candidates.why: The composite itself, in her words, at target length.

candidates.source_quote: Time no longer flows. / It branches.
candidates.why: The fork as time branching; more poetic than literal. Note: #097 is rank 1 at 19 and 34.

candidates.source_quote: Wave. Particle. Wave. Particle.
candidates.why: One woman in two states at once, in the rhythm of the surf; from her quantum chapter.

slots.feeling: walking out of the ring; nobody's wife, self-possessed

candidates.source_quote: Закольцуешься чьим-то мужем. / Я останусь: ничьей женой, / Атуоной, горбатой старушкой / В целом с Богом и чуть - с Сатаной.
candidates.gist_en: You'll ring yourself in as someone's husband. I will remain nobody's wife, Atuona, a hunchbacked little old woman, on the whole with God, and a little with Satan.
candidates.why: She walks out of a closed ring of foam while the poem says 'you'll be ringed in as a husband; I stay nobody's wife': the last stanza of the title poem over the title shot.

candidates.source_quote: Снова жирная клякса на твоей репутации, / И отбеливать ты ее этой осенью не готов.
candidates.gist_en: Again a fat blot on your reputation, and this autumn you are not ready to whiten it.
candidates.why: Black linen and black sand, refusing to bleach: it reaches 'I will not whiten' without reusing the film #8 line. Note: #094 is rank 1 at 5.

candidates.source_quote: Я уже не твоя послушница. / И не твой этот день Рождения.
candidates.gist_en: I am no longer your novice. And this birthday is not yours.
candidates.why: Calm independence as she steps forward: a rebirth that belongs only to her.

slots.feeling: the sand stays black; the cycle returns

candidates.source_quote: Все закончится одиночеством. / Снова. / И с него же начнется.
candidates.gist_en: Everything will end in loneliness. Again. And it will begin from it, too.
candidates.why: Foam whitens the sand, draws back, and the sand is black again: an ending that loops the film back to 1a's silence, as the gallery loop does.

candidates.source_quote: Is the world still here? / Am I still here?
candidates.why: After the foam retreats the black sand gleams again, as if checking that reality survived.

candidates.source_quote: Something will happen, spill like ocean / over granite's endless shore.
candidates.why: From her oldest poem (2001), the sea spilling over a shore: eternity at the waterline as a quiet last word.
